newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Texas Instruments rises.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Texas Instruments rises.

text.p: Texas Instruments Inc rose in pre-open trade Tuesday, boosted by stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings, traders said.
They reported a generally quiet market weighing a wave of earnings reports. "The one that's dominating the news today is Texas Instruments," a trader said.
Texas Instruments was trading at 101-1/2, up from a Monday close of 97-8/16. Shares of the semiconductor maker had traded at 102-1/2 before easing.
The company reported second-quarter net earnings per share of $1.07, up from $0.21 a year before. A consensus estimate by First Call had forecast earnings of about $0.87 a share.

Among other shares, Tellabs Inc was trading at 62-3/4, up from a closing price of 61-11/16. The telecommunications equipment company reported earnings after the market's close Monday of $0.32 a share, versus a loss of $0.10 a year ago.
A consensus estimate by analysts had put the earnings a share at $0.29, a trader said.
